description: What the bundled boot page may do: listen for progress events and call the shell's own boot commands. Local origins only -- the SPA the backend serves over loopback is a remote origin and is granted separately, at runtime, for the one port it is actually on (see `grant_spa_render` in main.rs). Opening the browser and Finder is done from Rust, so no window is granted the ability to open arbitrary URLs. `render_page` is deliberately absent: the boot page has no use for it.
